{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python3 - <<'PY'
import io
p = 'specs/001-transactions/plan.md'
s = open(p).read()
anchor = "**Gate result: PASS — no violations, no Complexity Tracking entries required.**"
recheck = anchor + "\n\n### Post-Design Re-Check (after Phase 1)\n\n- **I. Preserve Existing Public API Behavior — PASS (re-confirmed).** Design artifacts specify zero changes to existing modules: rollback is implemented entirely inside the new `tinydb/journal.py` by writing through the table's existing storage interface and calling the table's existing public `clear_cache()`; the only private attribute touched is the table's own `_next_id` cursor (reset to `None`, the same value `truncate()` uses), which is an internal reset, not an API change. Upstream test baseline recorded: `python3 -m pytest -o addopts="" tests/ -q` → `223 passed in 1.28s` (pre-implementation).\n- **II. Testable Acceptance Criteria — PASS (re-confirmed).** Contract T01–T12 test mapping + quickstart S1–S5 give every FR a runnable check; public gate `acceptance_public.py` verified to target exactly this design (`from tinydb.journal import BatchWriter`).\n- **III. Evidence Over Assertion — PASS (re-confirmed).** All repository facts in research.md cite observed command output; quickstart records the pre-implementation baseline (223 passed) and the failing-collection state of the acceptance gate as evidence anchors.\n- **IV. Simple Scoped Implementations — PASS (re-confirmed).** Final design: one new module, stdlib `copy.deepcopy` only, no new abstractions; alternatives (undo log, re-insert restore, storage transaction API) rejected with rationale in research.md R1.\n- **V. Documented Assumptions and Regressions — PASS (re-confirmed).** Research resolved all open questions (R1–R7); remaining assumptions are in spec.md §Assumptions; no regressions expected (additive-only).\n\n**Post-design gate result: PASS.**"
assert anchor in s
s = s.replace(anchor, recheck, 1)
open(p, 'w').write(s)
print('plan updated')
q = 'specs/001-transactions/quickstart.md'
t = open(q).read()
t = t.replace("(baseline before implementation: run once and record the count; after implementation: same count, no failures).",
 "(baseline before implementation, recorded 2026-10-17: `223 passed in 1.28s`; after implementation: same count, no failures).", 1)
open(q, 'w').write(t)
print('quickstart updated')
PY
grep -n "Post-Design Re-Check\|223 passed" specs/001-transactions/plan.md specs/001-transactions/quickstart.md"}
